Avengers Endgame: Encore returns to theaters Friday 🍿🔥

🎥🎬: Avengers: Endgame

Following the devastating Snap, the Avengers are scattered and broken. Natasha Romanoff continues searching for a way to bring everyone back, while Steve Rogers tries to help survivors move forward. Everything changes when Scott Lang arrives with a message from the Quantum Realm.

The team realizes that the Infinity Stones could potentially reverse Thanos’ actions. They split into groups and journey through time to retrieve the Stones, but their plan becomes increasingly complicated as they interfere with events from their own history.

The Avengers eventually reunite for their biggest battle yet. Heroes from across the universe arrive to face Thanos, turning the fight into a massive final stand with the fate of countless lives hanging in the balance.
